newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Palestinian Authority ministers visit Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian Authority ministers visit Morocco.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority's housing and social services ministers arrived in Morocco for a visit to increase cooperation, the Moroccan news agency MAP said on Monday.
It said Housing Minister Abdel-Rahman Hamad and Social Services Minister Intissar al-Wazir arrived on Sunday night.

MAP quoted Hamad as saying on arrival that he appreciated King Hassan's political and economic support for the Palestinians and the visit would be an opportunity to benefit from Morocco's expertise in housing.
Wazir said she had been invited by Morocco's Labour and Social Affairs Minister Amine Demnati and her visit was intended to strengthen cooperation in social affairs.
